scope: Evidence acquired from public P1 through the pre-selection semantic-source cutoff for clusters first introduced in the v1.5 future cohort.
principles: Content custody is not by itself semantic exposure.
A copied semantic unit does not become machine contact merely because a program stored it.
Classification is by proved producer, operation, output schema, and delivery path, never by favorable target effect.
Mixed or unverifiable captured evidence units are UNKNOWN and exclude every exactly joined cluster.
Delivery to a proved nonparticipant with zero ingress into the controlled harness is outside the boundary and creates no evidence unit.
A missing, possible, or unregistered ingress into a frozen participant is PROTOCOL_INVALID and cannot be downgraded to UNKNOWN.
Before C1 there are no human participants and no model endpoints; after C1 every arm and verifier receives a fresh isolated context.
This ontology cannot reclassify Method v1.4 evidence or recover its 728 development clusters.

SEMANTIC_EXPOSURE.definition: During the P1-through-pre-selection source interval, a target statement, mathematical meaning, status, residual, family, proof or disproof route, transformation, candidate, or target-specific result was delivered to or produced for a frozen experimental participant. Those pre-C1 participants are machine-only.
examples: manual target inspection that influences or controls the harness
research prose or code comment about a target
issue, pull request, release, or commit message discussing a target

MACHINE_REGISTRY_CONTACT.definition: An allowlisted content-addressed executable performed only frozen identity, syntax, ancestry, grouping, provenance, eligibility, count, hashing, or deterministic selection operations and emitted a validated bounded schema without target semantics.
requirements: output validates against a P1-frozen bounded schema
no statement text, residual, interpretation, candidate, route, or result is emitted
output is not delivered through an unbounded natural-language channel

IMMUTABLE_SOURCE_CUSTODY.definition: Exact upstream or vendor bytes are retained as content-addressed source material, but no semantic presentation to a frozen experimental participant is evidenced.
requirements: source origin and bytes are proved
pre-C1 decoding is restricted to a frozen machine-contact executable
no pre-C1 human-facing or model-facing rendering occurred inside the participant boundary
custody metadata itself contains no target semantics
IMMUTABLE_SOURCE_CUSTODY.note: If source bytes reach a frozen pre-C1 participant semantically, the rendered unit is SEMANTIC_EXPOSURE even though the stored blob remains source custody. Independent delivery outside the boundary is irrelevant only when zero participant ingress is proved. Post-C1 target delivery is governed by the isolated arm protocol, not this pre-selection exclusion class.

UNKNOWN.definition: For a captured evidence unit, the source completeness, producer, operation, output schema, delivery path, semantic contact level, or exact candidate binding cannot be proved. UNKNOWN is not available when the missing fact is whether an unregistered ingress reached a frozen participant; that is protocol invalidity.
examples: captured source unit with incomplete metadata

includes: authenticated upstream Git objects retained under private immutable custody
signed ai-vps-controlled-harness ingress and egress receipts
bounded public scheduler requests and checkpoint publications consumed or authored by frozen machine participants
declared generated artifacts consumed by frozen participants
machine registry outputs and their provenance receipts
excluded_surfaces: tmux, agent-sync, general interactive VPS sessions, and local relay
public platform content never consumed by a frozen participant
source_boundary.excluded_surface_condition: Every excluded surface must have proved zero ingress or control influence into the frozen participant boundary.
source_boundary.upstream_nonintervention: Frozen experimenter identities abstain from influencing future-cohort formal-conjectures clusters; machine-detectable contact excludes the conflicted cluster and unreported or unattributable intervention invalidates the protocol.

v1_4_non_reinterpretation.rule: Method v1.4 remains terminal under its own frozen provenance policy; this prospective ontology applies only after v1.5 P1.
